```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.cursor/**'
      - '.mcp.json'
      - 'docs/ai/**'

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for Next.js version mismatch
        id: check-version
        run: |
          # Extract version from AGENTS.md (looking for next@X.Y.Z pattern)
          AGENTS_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'next@\K[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' AGENTS.md | head -n 1 || echo "")
          
          # Extract version from docs/ai/rules/general.md if it exists
          GENERAL_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'next@\K[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' docs/ai/rules/general.md 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || echo "")
          
          # Extract version from docs/ai/working-set.md if it exists
          WORKING_SET_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'next@\K[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' docs/ai/working-set.md 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || echo "")
          
          echo "AGENTS_VERSION=$AGENTS_VERSION"
          echo "GENERAL_VERSION=$GENERAL_VERSION"
          echo "WORKING_SET_VERSION=$WORKING_SET_VERSION"
          
          if [ -n "$AGENTS_VERSION" ] && [ -n "$GENERAL_VERSION" ] && [ "$AGENTS_VERSION" != "$GENERAL_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "MISMATCH=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "MESSAGE=Version mismatch detected: AGENTS.md has $AGENTS_VERSION, but docs/ai/rules/general.md has $GENERAL_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [ -n "$AGENTS_VERSION" ] && [ -n "$WORKING_SET_VERSION" ] && [ "$AGENTS_VERSION" != "$WORKING_SET_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "MISMATCH=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "MESSAGE=Version mismatch detected: AGENTS.md has $AGENTS_VERSION, but docs/ai/working-set.md has $WORKING_SET_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "MISMATCH=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Notify Code Owner via PR Comment
        if: steps.check-version.outputs.MISMATCH == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const message = `## ⚠️ Next.js Version Mismatch Detected

            **${{ steps.check-version.outputs.MESSAGE }}**

            Please ensure that \`AGENTS.md\` reflects the current Next.js version used in the repository to avoid incorrect agent decisions.

            **Files to check:**
            - \`AGENTS.md\`
            - \`docs/ai/rules/general.md\`
            - \`docs/ai/working-set.md\`
            `;
            
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: message
            });
```
